cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

mechanism: A presents reconciliation as a staged expert process, then must invent actual restitution when B points out the offered biscuits are the very grievance.
confusable: D66 confidently performs authorised procedure; D90 specifically invents relationship-repair steps as immediate contributions overturn the supposed plan.
comparison: Listening alternative adapts who records interruptions; biscuit alternative turns failed refreshments into replacing what A took.
seedUse: Stage-two biscuit, missing stage one and improvised honesty credit derive from D90-b; candidate replaces abstract process question with a concrete grievance and corrective task.
